purpose: Complete the fixed-truth Z10 diagnostic using the exact independent Gaussian radial-calibration posterior. No new physical model or data.

factorization.domain: Only the fixed native density/velocity experiment with the current independent nuisance priors. This independence does not apply when fields are inferred as in Z9.
factorization.coordinates: u=(nuisance_0:20,nuisance_24); q=nuisance_20:24. Counts depend only on u and fixed fields; radial velocities depend only on q and fixed fields. p(u,q|D,fixed fields)=p(u|counts)*p(q|radial).
factorization.Gaussian: A=B*diag(q_std), r=radial_data-radial_prediction(fixed_velocity,q=0), W=diag(1/variance), using training rows only. Precision P=I+A^T W A; mean=P^-1 A^T W r; covariance=P^-1.
factorization.reuse: Retain every saved post-warmup u sample from all four Z10 chains, with no thinning, chain selection, bias correction or rescaling. Replace only q by independently seeded exact Gaussian draws. Recompute full log posterior through the analytic quadratic difference and verify against the original objective.
factorization.prediction: Integrate the four-dimensional q posterior exactly for each heldout radial row, including its added predictive variance. Keep the original pointwise score convention, which omits fixed Gaussian observation constants. This is not a joint predictive evidence.

checks: saved Z9 mock and frozen regenerated data agreement
original objective/count invariance validates factorization at two parameter settings
Gaussian precision positive definite, solution residuals, and heldout exclusion
retained 21-coordinate marginal and reconstructed 25-coordinate joint plus log posterior pass unchanged Rhat/ESS gates
independent Gaussian draws agree with exact mean/covariance within fixed Monte Carlo tolerances
all retained nonradial samples and curvature quantiles remain unchanged
direct original objective agrees with repaired log posterior at checked stored draws

assessment.scope: A correction of one exactly soluble block, not a relaxation of convergence gates. If the retained marginal or reconstructed joint fails, report NO_GO; no automatic rerun or promotion.
assessment.science: Compare curvature recovery with Z9 to localize field-inference/coupling effects. Does not isolate field-prior error alone, validate galaxies or reconstruct real CF4 density.
